system.target: Caster, or nearby Terrestrial or Celestial Circle sorcery spell, or nearby Shadowlands, Labyrinth or Void Circle necromancy spell
system.description: This spell functions just like Iron Countermagic (see page 30), except that it can affect all necromancy. Obsidian Countermagic also dispels sorcery of the Terrestrial or Celestial Circles.
